axiom_gate.reason: All claims follow from the already-derived P46 model, exact Frobenius certificates, representation theory, and established theorems of Deligne, Faltings, and Larsen-Pink.

hard_boundaries: No claim is made that P46, the common cover, or the period-covector construction is a new axiom or Foundation primitive.
The full Sato-Tate component group is not inferred merely from End^0=Q(i); only the identity component is fixed.
The proof uses connected l-adic monodromy groups; component groups require separate descent analysis.
The Hodge/Tate conclusions concern powers of P46 and do not automatically transfer to the full genus-five Jacobian without separately combining the elliptic factor.
P000 remains unchanged and is neither proved nor challenged.
